d:
Bihar men bhumihin aur jaruratmand parivaron ko sarkar jamin dene ja rahi hai. rajy men uplabdh 6235 ekar bhudan ki jamin ka vitran jaruratmand logon ke bich kiya jaega. rajasv evan bhumi sudhar mantri dilip jayasval ne bataya ki bihar bhudan yagy samiti ko bhang karne ka phaisla liya gaya hai. sarkar purane jamin aavantan ki bhi janch karaegi. janie bhudan ki jamin ke vitran se kin logon ko mil sakta hai phayda.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
